title: Lesson 29: Where There's Smoke...
summary: Anna becomes a fire safety monitor. But will she do a good job? And when will she use her skills?

Emergency Language
Today, you learned important language to use for fire emergencies. Study and remember them. How many can you remember?

Do you smell smoke?
